thread:
incbot: INCIDENT ALERT — org_id=org_hearthly_42 generating sustained 8k qps to text-generate route. Latency P95 > 2.5s, error rate 5%. Paging oncall.
Sara_Oncall: paging in, looking now. @mike_sre are you on morning rota?
Mike_SRE: here, joining. seeing huge burst from hearthly, looks like batch ingestion job firing. logs show repeated /v1/generate calls with long prompts.
Sara_Oncall: confirming impact: platform-wide queueing for 30s windows, Affects hosted customers with small reserved capacity. We need quick mitigation to avoid broader outage.
Aline_ProdEng: quick thought: we can either throttle hearthly down or lift their per-org limit temporarily to let them finish onboarding. Customer SLA? @eva_pm
Eva_PM: Hearthly is Enterprise on Dedicated on ramp—they're currently onboarding a big partner. If we throttle them they will see timeouts. CS asks for minimal disruption.
Marco_Support: CS on call, Hearthly engineering pasted this: "mass import script hit prod and misconfigured concurrency". They can pause if we ask but need time.
Mike_SRE: proposal: apply a constrained override — increase hearthly token bucket to 500rps for 10 minutes and simultaneously apply a global per-route degrade rule to cap unknown orgs. That preserves platform.
Sara_Oncall: +1. How do we apply override? Is there an admin endpoint?
Aline_ProdEng: use admin API: POST https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/org_hearthly_42/overrides
payload:
```
{"rate_limit_override": {"rps": 500, "burst": 1000, "expires_at": "2026-03-15T18:20:00Z"}}
```
You need org-admin token. Also recommend toggling "streaming":false to conserve token costs.
Mike_SRE: I'm executing now (audit note: performing emergency per-org override as mitigant). curl command:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -X POST \
  -d '{"rate_limit_override":{"rps":500,"burst":1000,"expires_at":"2026-03-15T18:20:00Z"}}' \
  https://admin.redwood.internal/orgs/org_hearthly_42/overrides
```
Mike_SRE: got 200 OK. Override active. Confirming tokens applied.
Incbot: ACTION LOG — override applied by mike_sre at 2026-03-15T18:05:12Z, id=ovr_9a3b
Sara_Oncall: immediate metrics — hearthly qps dropped 95% of queued requests, overall P95 latency back to 0.95s. Errors down. Good.
Marco_Support: telling Hearthly to throttle their import script now (ask them to pause). Sending DM.
Jordan_TS: also enabling a temporary route-level soft-degrade for text-generate for tiers below enterprise to prevent cascading. Patch applied to live-routing (canary 10%).
Aline_ProdEng: note: we should also add a short-term quota enforcement for key endpoints to prevent repeated surges. I'll open a follow-up ticket.
Eva_PM: CS to follow up with customer with timeline and confirmation once their team shuts import.
Sara_Oncall: handoff: I'll stay for next 20 mins for monitoring, then hand to Mike for postmortem. Mike - do you want the handoff now?
Mike_SRE: I'll take the handoff. I'll keep the override until Hearthly confirms pausing then expire it sooner if OK. Creating incident doc.
Marco_Support: Hearthly confirmed they paused the job. They appreciate the emergency lift and asked for an account-level best-practices doc.
Incbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — last action by mike_sre at 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z. Status: mitigated. Will track follow-up: add per-org safe-guards, update onboarding docs, and a runbook step to contact CS before emergency lifts.
Sara_Oncall: closing thread for active mitigation. Ready for postmortem items and tickets.
Mike_SRE: ack — adding timeline and commands to incident ticket. Will set override to expire in 5 minutes if Hearthly confirms.
Marco_Support: leaving note for billing to check if we should bill for overages or consider one-time credit.
Sara_Oncall: thanks team :thumbsup:
